reader.requirement: A unique name may still be qualified, and any combination of qualifiers (not every level need be written) that makes a reference unique is accepted.
reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate; QualifierWalk consults no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: condition-name and data-name chains; file-name, cd-name, report-name and procedure-name qualifiers of a unique name are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: AAAA BBBB / CCCC DDDD / OK-R1-A OK-R1-B OK-R2-C OK-R2-D / 78 / 123 / CCCC / UNIQ / ZZZZZ / FFF12GGG34
probes.expected: every reference made unique by its qualifiers resolves to its own item: full and gapped chains, IN and OF mixed, record-name as data-name-1 and as qualifier, file-name qualifier, condition-names qualified by their conditional variable and its groups, subscripted qualified items, an unqualified unique name
DEST-COUNT OF CDA and DEST-COUNT IN OREC2 IN CDB resolve through format 1's cd-name qualifier
qualified RECORD KEY, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, RELATIVE KEY, FILE STATUS and READ KEY IS resolve; indexed dynamic and relative random; a failed READ gives 23

probes.printed: exit 0: FOUND BBB / NOT FOUND 30 / ENT FOUND
probes.expected: ODO counter CNT OF GC OF CTLS (value 3, then 2) bounds the SEARCH ALL; KEY IS K OF ROW, K2 IN KG OF ROW and KEY IS ENT (the subject) resolve

probes.printed: exit 0: S1-P1 / S2-P1 x3 / S1-P2 / S1-P1 / S1-P2 / LC 03 02 / END
probes.expected: P1 OF S1, P1 IN S2, unqualified P1 from within S2, PERFORM P1 OF S1 THRU P2 IN S1, GO TO FIN OF S9, LINAGE-COUNTER OF/IN file all resolve

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.2  the text is in SRL2.2 (quoted: A name can be qualified even though it does not need qualification)

reader.notes: QualifierWalk consumes the written qualifiers inner to outer with gaps, so X OF R1 (skipping G), X OF G OF R1, OK OF R2 and OK IN C IN R1 all resolve; unique names qualified needlessly (K2 IN KG OF ROW, KY OF IREC, P2 OF S1) resolve.

refuter.evidence: recq.cob: record-name R in two FDs, MOVE TO R OF F1 / R IN F2, IF AOK OF R OF F1, IF AOK IN A IN F2 (skipping the record), WRITE R OF F1 -> C1 C2 AAA BBB. sdq.cob: SORT KEY K OF SREC OF SF, RELEASE SREC IN SF, K OF SF (gapped) -> 1 2 3. ok2.cob: DEPENDING ON CNT OF F1 / CNT IN FR IN F2, KEY K OF T OF FR OF F1 / K IN F2, KEY U OF R1 -> F1 FOUND 3, F2 FOUND 6, NF2 OK, U FOUND. cite: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.2  the text is in SRL2.2.
